description: Payoff, breakeven(s), and max profit/loss for a Deribit BTC/ETH vertical spread (2 legs, same option type, opposite direction, e.g. a bull call spread) or an iron condor/butterfly (4 legs: 2 calls + 2 puts) at a scenario price. Coin-settled, and the max profit/loss are genuinely NOT the flat, textbook USD-settled values: because each leg's own payoff is divided by the settlement price, (1) a debit vertical spread's peak payoff occurs exactly at its short strike, not "anywhere beyond it" - and its profit is a finite WINDOW that closes again at a high enough price, decaying back toward a full loss of the premium paid, and (2) an iron condor/butterfly's max loss is genuinely UNBOUNDED toward price->0 (maxLossCoin: null) if it has a put wing, unlike the "capped at wing width" USD-settled result - only the call side is actually bounded. Use when user asks about a bull/bear call/put spread, vertical spread, iron condor, or iron butterfly, e.g. "what's my max loss on this BTC call spread?" or "where do my iron condor breakevens sit?". Returns: structureType (vertical_spread/iron_condor/iron_butterfly, inferred from the legs given), netDebitCoin (negative = credit received), scenarioPayoffCoin, scenarioPnlCoin/Usd, breakevenPrices (0-3, ascending), maxLossCoin/maxProfitCoin (null = unbounded), isProfitable. With exchange "binance" (USDT-settled, flat payoff) the textbook shapes apply instead of the coin-settled ones above: an iron condor's max loss is bounded (wing width less the credit) and a debit spread keeps its full profit above the short strike; it returns: structureType, netDebitUsdt, scenarioPayoffUsdt, scenarioPnlUsdt, breakevenPrices (ascending), maxLossUsdt (the worst P&L, negative when a loss; null = unbounded) and maxProfitUsdt (null = unbounded), isProfitable; USDT is not converted to USD.

currency.description: Underlying. Default BTC. XAU and XAG (gold, silver) only with exchange binance.

exchange.description: Venue whose settlement rules apply. "deribit" (default): BTC/ETH, coin-settled, premium in the base coin. "binance": BTC/ETH/XAU/XAG, USDT-settled, flat payoff max(0, S-K) per unit, premium in USDT (leg premiumUsdt); the result carries exchange and settlement fields.

legs.description: Exactly 2 legs (same option type, opposite position - a vertical spread) or 4 legs (2 calls + 2 puts - an iron condor/butterfly). Each leg: { optionType: call|put, position: long|short, strike: number, premiumCoin: number } for Deribit, premiumUsdt instead of premiumCoin for Binance.

premiumCoin.description: Deribit only. Premium per contract, in the base coin

premiumUsdt.description: Binance only. Premium per unit, in USDT

scenarioPrice.description: Underlying price in USD to evaluate the payoff at
